831914010:int:557717086.h: Five interceptions bury S.Jones and East Carolina against Charlotte
831914010:int:557717086.d: The Pirates' quarterback kept throwing into traffic, and Charlotte kept taking the gifts. Pirate_flag now has a week to decide whether this was one ugly afternoon or a pattern.

quote.text: He kept staring down his first read and the safeties knew it by halftime.
quote.by: a source close to the program

831914837:comeback.h: Clemson rallies from 11 down in the fourth to stun Boston College
831914837:comeback.d: Boston College had it in hand heading into the final quarter. Clemson wouldn't let go, and the Eagles' sideline looked shell-shocked as the last drive played out. Nobody in that building will forget it soon.

quote.text: Nobody on our sideline flinched. Not once.

831914506:ot.h: Indiana survives Minnesota in a 48-46 overtime shootout
831914506:ot.d: Neither defense could get a stop for long, and the extra period only raised the stakes. Indiana finally got the last word. Minnesota's staff will wonder how a game with that much offense slipped away.

831914749:4th:832438343.h: Mississippi State's fourth-down gambles backfire against Tennessee
831914749:4th:832438343.d: Mississippi State kept the punt team on the sideline and Tennessee kept getting the ball back near midfield. The staff's aggression has some in the fan base grumbling about game management.

quote.text: You can be bold, but at some point you have to flip the field.

832438366:streakW6.h: Penn State climbs to No. 16 as Agerm40 keeps the streak quiet
832438366:streakW6.d: Six straight wins have the Nittany Lions at 6-1 and back in the national conversation. Agerm40 is trying to keep the noise out of the building, and players say the message is landing. Recruits are noticing too.

quote.text: We don't talk about the streak. We talk about Tuesday practice.

831914626:ot.h: Boise State edges Fresno State 33-30 in overtime
831914626:ot.d: Boise State won it in the extra period, 6-3, after regulation left both sides gasping. Fresno State had chances to close it out and let them slip. That one will sting on the bus ride home.

831914638:int:557718877.h: Six picks from L.Moga sink New Mexico against Air Force
831914638:int:557718877.d: New Mexico's quarterback never found a rhythm, and Air Force took full advantage. Moga did throw a touchdown, but the six interceptions were the story. Questions about how long he stays the starter will follow the Lobos all week.

quote.text: You could feel it slipping away after the third one.
quote.by: a source close to the New Mexico program

831914779:int:557725258.h: J.Long's three picks hand Georgia a win over Kentucky
831914779:int:557725258.d: Kentucky moved the ball but turned it over too often, and Georgia cashed in. The win gives the Bulldogs a nice talking point with the recruits they're chasing, including Tippmann and Leber. Kentucky's quarterback will want this one back.

831914535:pass:557723017.h: D.Williams Jr. throws for 472 yards as Nebraska handles Washington
831914535:pass:557723017.d: Nebraska's quarterback was precise all afternoon and never gave Washington a turnover. Pro scouts reportedly circled the game. It was a quiet kind of dominance that deserves more attention.

quote.text: He's the calmest guy in the building and it shows.

831914840:4th:832438314.h: Georgia State's fourth-down calls fall flat against James Madison
831914840:4th:832438314.d: Georgia State kept rolling the dice and kept losing the bet. The analytics crowd will defend the approach. Fans leaving the stadium were not buying it, and the grumbling is only getting louder.

quote.text: Just kick it. Please.

831914853:rivalry.h: Miami runs away with the Virginia Tech rivalry game
831914853:rivalry.d: This one was never in doubt. Miami took control early and owns the series for another year. The Hokies' staff will be hearing about it from their fans all week.

831914324:pass:557715753.h: W.Hammond's 447 yards power Texas Tech past Jacksonville State
831914324:pass:557715753.d: Texas Tech's offense rolled, and Hammond never threw an interception. Jacksonville State's secondary had no answers. A source says the quarterback is already hearing from NFL-minded agents.

quote.text: Everything he threw was on time and on target.

831914822:4th:832438330.h: Louisiana's fourth-down tries cost it against Arkansas State
831914822:4th:832438330.d: Louisiana kept going for it and turning it over on downs, handing Arkansas State short fields. The coaching staff will have to answer for the decision-making this week.

831914533:def:557717690.h: J.Reeshad terrorizes Purdue with 3.5 sacks in Oregon win
831914533:def:557717690.d: Oregon's pass rusher spent the day in Purdue's backfield and made life miserable for the Boilermakers' quarterback. Rival staffers are already asking about his eligibility timeline.

quote.text: We couldn't block him. Simple as that.

831914441:pass:557720861.h: A.Schobel throws for 455 yards and five TDs but still loses to Iowa State
831914441:pass:557720861.d: Schobel did everything a quarterback can do, and it still wasn't enough in a 49-47 defeat. The two interceptions will haunt him. His teammates were visibly crushed afterward.

quote.text: He gave us everything. We let him down.

831914559:int:557711829.h: D.Bailey's three interceptions sink Sam Houston against Kennesaw State
831914559:int:557711829.d: Sam Houston's quarterback couldn't protect the football, and Kennesaw State pounced. Bailey did throw two touchdowns, but the turnovers killed momentum. The film session will not be pleasant.

831914575:ot.h: New Mexico State edges Missouri State 30-27 in overtime
831914575:ot.d: New Mexico State won the extra session 6-3 after a back-and-forth game. Missouri State had its chances, and the coaching staff will wonder about a few late decisions.

quote.text: Both teams left everything on the field.
quote.by: a source close to the New Mexico State program

831914610:ot.h: Eastern Michigan holds off Ohio 32-30 in overtime
831914610:ot.d: Eastern Michigan took the extra period 15-13 in a game that went down to the final snap. Ohio's players were slow to leave the field after the final whistle.

831914663:ot.h: Toledo beats Miami University 38-31 in overtime
831914663:ot.d: Toledo took the extra period 7-0 to survive. Miami University's sideline was stunned, and the defensive staff will wonder what they could have done differently.

831914566:flags:832438341.h: Penalties pile up as Middle Tennessee falls to Liberty
831914566:flags:832438341.d: Middle Tennessee drew 13 flags for 97 yards, and Liberty took advantage. Sources say the head coach was livid on the sideline. Expect a heavy dose of discipline drills this week.

quote.text: Coach made it pretty clear we're not doing this again.

831914686:rivalry.h: LSU takes the Texas A&M rivalry game without much trouble
831914686:rivalry.d: It wasn't close. LSU controlled the game and owns bragging rights for another year. Texas A&M's fans left early, and the pressure on that staff is rising.

831913999:def:557711553.h: J.Allen's four sacks lead Memphis past Temple
831913999:def:557711553.d: Memphis got a monster game from its defensive lineman, who spent the afternoon in the Temple backfield. Temple's offensive line struggled all day. Scouts are paying attention.

quote.text: Nobody on that line could block him one-on-one.

831914890:def:557725233.h: X.Lewis wrecks Stanford's backfield with three sacks in a loss
831914890:def:557725233.d: X.Lewis was a one-man wrecking crew against Stanford, with five tackles for loss. The performance wasn't enough to save his team. Rival coaches reportedly took notice.

quote.text: He deserved a better result than that.
quote.by: a source close to the program

831914349:flags:832438374.h: San Jose State flagged 12 times in loss to UConn
831914349:flags:832438374.d: San Jose State beat itself, racking up 95 penalty yards in a loss to UConn. Discipline will be the focus of practice this week, and the head coach didn't hide his frustration afterward.

831914510:3rd:832438318.h: Illinois can't convert on third down in loss to UCLA
831914510:3rd:832438318.d: Illinois went 2-for-11 on third down, and drive after drive died on the money down. The offensive staff will face questions about play-calling in obvious passing situations.

quote.text: We just couldn't stay on the field.

831914849:rec:557715761.h: M.Hamper torches Florida State for 175 yards and a score
831914849:rec:557715761.d: The receiver caught eight passes and gave Florida State's corners fits all afternoon. His longest was 52 yards. A Florida State defensive staffer admitted afterward that they had no answer for him.

quote.text: We couldn't cover him. Plain and simple.

561124210battle.h: Georgia holds the edge on Tippmann, but Ohio State is pushing hard
561124210battle.d: Georgia is slightly ahead for B. Tippmann, with Ohio State close behind and Alabama lurking. Proximity to home is his dealbreaker, and official visits could swing it. Tuddy_roosevelt's staff is reportedly planning a big push.

quote.text: He wants to be close to home, and that matters a lot to the family.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

561119306battle.h: Penn State clings to a slim lead for Q. Vigil
561119306battle.d: Agerm40's winning streak is helping, and Penn State barely leads Texas for Q. Vigil, with Florida close behind. Conference prestige is his dealbreaker, and both staffs are expected to go all out this week.

quote.text: Winning matters to him, and Penn State is winning.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

561125692battle.h: [[t:832438375|SMU]] and [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] are in a late fight for five-star WILL [[r:561125692|B. Toviessi]]
561125692battle.d: SMU holds the edge but Oklahoma is pushing hard, with LSU lurking. Toviessi's dealbreaker is conference prestige, and a source says the Sooners' staff has been working that angle all week.

quote.text: He keeps asking about the league. That's what he cares about.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

561122126battle.h: [[t:832438312|Georgia]] has a slim edge on [[t:832438384|Texas]] for [[r:561122126|P. Leber]], but nothing is settled
561122126battle.d: Georgia holds a slight lead, Texas is right behind and Ohio State is lurking. Leber's dealbreaker is playing style, and Georgia's loss to Mississippi State could shake things up.

quote.text: He wants to see how he fits in the offense. That's the whole thing.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

561124114battle.h: Notre Dame and Utah are staring each other down for five-star Virgin
561124114battle.d: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] has a slight edge for athlete [[r:561124114|C. Virgin]], but [[t:832438400|Utah]] hasn't blinked and SMU is still in the picture. Playing time is the dealbreaker, and both staffs know it.

quote.text: He's asked every coach the same question: where do I line up in September? That's the whole recruitment.
quote.by: a source close to the recruitment

561119798battle.h: Colorado holds a thin lead for Manuwai, but Georgia is pushing back hard
561119798battle.d: [[t:832438295|Colorado]] is slightly ahead for four-star linebacker [[r:561119798|L. Manuwai]], who cares most about playing style. [[t:832438312|Georgia]] is not conceding, and LSU is still lurking.

quote.text: He wants to know how he'll be used, not how the helmet looks. Whoever sells that best wins.
quote.by: a person familiar with his thinking

561120351commit.h: Georgia gets its man: five-star receiver Duggan picks the Bulldogs
561120351commit.d: [[r:561120351|J. Duggan]] wanted a team built for January, and [[t:832438312|Georgia]] gave him the strongest pitch. The NIL ranking didn't hurt, with his reported asking price at $410K.

quote.text: I'm trying to win a natty. They're built for it.

561124450commit.h: Reinbolt picks Alabama after the Tide's win over Florida sealed it
561124450commit.d: [[r:561124450|A. Reinbolt]] fell for the head coach's honesty, and [[t:832438274|Alabama]]'s win over No. 24 [[t:832438308|Florida]] only made the decision easier. Rivals reportedly saw this coming weeks ago.

quote.text: The head coach was real with me from day one.

561121384commit.h: Indiana wins Hamrick, and the Minnesota result carried real weight
561121384commit.d: Four-star linebacker [[r:561121384|T. Hamrick]] is headed to [[t:832438319|Indiana]], which strengthened its title pitch with a win over No. 18 [[t:832438342|Minnesota]]. The Hoosiers' title case played well in the final calls.

quote.text: I want rings. Simple as that.

561120600commit.h: Texas Tech beat LSU and Kansas State for Pope after a blowout win
561120600commit.d: [[r:561120600|M. Pope]] chose [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] over [[t:832438333|LSU]] and [[t:832438325|Kansas State]]. The 52-14 win over [[t:832438322|Jacksonville State]] looked like a statement to him, and he said so privately.

quote.text: Watching them play, I could see myself in that locker room, and that's what I wanted.
quote.by: a source close to the program

561125736commit.h: Ole Miss gets a rusher who sees a clear path to playing time
561125736commit.d: [[r:561125736|J. Abbott]] saw seniors [[p:557719851|Y.Pierre]] and [[p:557715042|K.Franklin]] about to graduate and committed to [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]]. The Rebels' record of producing NFL defensive linemen helped too.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.

561125364commit.h: Notre Dame beats Texas and Michigan for Hammer after the USC win
561125364commit.d: [[r:561125364|J. Hammer]] picked [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] over [[t:832438384|Texas]] and [[t:832438339|Michigan]]. The 21-16 rivalry win over [[t:832438398|USC]] reportedly closed the deal, and the Irish are in a good week on the trail.

quote.text: I want rings. Simple as that.

561123749commit.h: Utah wins Davis on the strength of its head coach's pitch
561123749commit.d: [[r:561123749|J. Davis]] chose [[t:832438400|Utah]], where [[p:557714121|E.Day]] and [[p:557718724|J.Mickens]] are about to leave a hole at edge. It's a good day in Salt Lake, even with the Virgin race still undecided.

quote.text: The head coach was real with me from day one.

561119452commit.h: Oregon's NFL line pipeline lands another tackle in Jose
561119452commit.d: [[t:832438364|Oregon]] has a standout offensive line development record, and [[r:561119452|A. Jose]] bought it. His reported ask was $265K, and the Ducks' NIL muscle matched it, according to people around the process.

quote.text: I want to play on Sundays. They put guys in the league.

561121196commit.h: Ole Miss adds a second edge rusher, and Burns wanted the spotlight
561121196commit.d: [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] has now landed another edge rusher in [[r:561121196|P. Burns]], who valued the TV exposure as much as the depth chart. The Rebels' defensive line pipeline sealed it.

quote.text: Every week we're on TV. That matters for my brand.

561124523commit.h: LeBeau picks Oklahoma after being told the receiver job is wide open
561124523commit.d: [[r:561124523|C. LeBeau]] liked the spotlight at [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] but loved the short path to snaps. With only seven receivers returning, a staff source says the coaches were blunt about the opportunity.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.

561123309commit.h: UCLA beats BYU for Ojulari, who loved the head coach
561123309commit.d: [[r:561123309|K. Ojulari]] picked [[t:832438394|UCLA]] over [[t:832438288|BYU]] after what he called an honest recruiting pitch. His reported $255K ask fit the Bruins' NIL room.

quote.text: The head coach was real with me from day one.

561123468commit.h: Clemson lands Doss, who wanted the brand and got it
561123468commit.d: [[t:832438293|Clemson]] adds athlete [[r:561123468|B. Doss]], who wanted a national stage and a reported $285K. The staff has been busy since that wild comeback over Boston College.

quote.text: Every week we're on TV. That matters for my brand.

561124212commit.h: Texas lands Paillant, a small win after losing Hammer
561124212commit.d: [[r:561124212|M. Paillant]] picked [[t:832438384|Texas]], which has an opening at linebacker once [[p:557721040|K.Sherman]] graduates. After losing Hammer to Notre Dame, the Longhorns needed this.

quote.text: The NFL is the goal, and Texas develops linebackers better than anybody.

561125337commit.h: Ansah picks Texas A&M even after calling home a dealbreaker
561125337commit.d: [[r:561125337|D. Ansah]] had listed proximity as a must, then picked [[t:832438385|Texas A&M]] anyway. The Aggies' thin linebacker room and a direct pitch about playing time apparently outweighed everything.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.

561125516commit.h: Miami adds Emery, and the Virginia Tech win helped
561125516commit.d: [[t:832438337|Miami]] landed edge rusher [[r:561125516|J. Emery]], who wants to chase a national title. The 32-18 win over [[t:832438406|Virginia Tech]] came at a perfect time.

quote.text: I'm trying to win a natty. They're built for it.

561123015commit.h: California's Goedeke stays home and commits to UCLA
561123015commit.d: [[r:561123015|E. Goedeke]] never really considered leaving the Golden State, and [[t:832438394|UCLA]] benefited. His reported $270K ask was no problem for the Bruins' NIL budget.

quote.text: I'm representing San Juan Capistrano. Staying close was always the plan.

561119694commit.h: USC lands Heflin, a receiver who wants the national stage
561119694commit.d: [[r:561119694|L. Heflin]] chose [[t:832438398|USC]] for the exposure, and the Trojans' track record at receiver made it easy. It's a quiet bounce-back after the loss to Notre Dame.

quote.text: Every week we're on TV. That matters for my brand.

561123609commit.h: Miami adds another title-chaser in linebacker Wells
561123609commit.d: [[r:561123609|L. Wells]] picked [[t:832438337|Miami]] because he wants a title shot, and the spot left by [[p:557720045|C.Pruitt]] is a bonus. The Canes' recruiting classes keep stacking.

quote.text: I want rings. Simple as that.

561124656commit.h: Nebraska runs away with Coffee, leaving Florida in the dust
561124656commit.d: [[r:561124656|D. Coffee]] chose [[t:832438348|Nebraska]] because he wants a power-conference stage, and the Huskers built a wide lead over [[t:832438308|Florida]]. A source says Florida's staff knew it was over weeks ago.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

557723218:underpaid.h: W.Wilson is an 89-overall QB paid like a backup
557723218:underpaid.d: [[p:557723218|W.Wilson]] makes nothing in NIL while peers at his rating get serious money. A source says agents and collectives already know it.

quote.text: He's the most underpriced quarterback in the country. Somebody will fix that.

557720389:underpaid.h: B.Riker's price tag is climbing. Can Penn State keep him?
557720389:underpaid.d: [[p:557720389|B.Riker]], an 85-overall center, makes 30K while peers command around 75K. After the loss to Indiana, [[t:832438366|Penn State]] has another reason to worry about holding its line together.

quote.text: Interior linemen at that rating don't stay cheap for long.

557717122:fit.h: Is J.Joseph's future outside Penn State? The pass defense says maybe
557717122:fit.d: An 82-overall field corner, [[p:557717122|J.Joseph]], plays on one of the worst pass defenses in the country. [[t:832438366|Penn State]] is winning, but the scheme may not suit a corner of his caliber.

quote.text: Guys that good want to be in a system that lets them make plays, and right now that's not happening.

557726826:fit.h: J.Zayas could be a portal name if Penn State's pass D doesn't improve
557726826:fit.d: [[p:557726826|J.Zayas]] is an 82-overall field corner on a [[t:832438366|Penn State]] defense that gives up too many passing yards. Agerm40 may have to fix the secondary or watch it walk.

quote.text: Two good corners on a leaky pass defense. Somebody is going to ask them if they want out.

557722831:buried.h: I.West is too good to sit and has options
557722831:buried.d: [[p:557722831|I.West]], an 85-overall sophomore back, has played 60 snaps in 8 games. A source says his camp has begun discussing what a portal move could look like.

quote.text: He wants a bigger role. Another year behind people isn't the plan.
quote.by: a source close to the player

557720545:buried.h: Ohio State's A.Rogers could leave from No. 4 on the depth chart
557720545:buried.d: [[p:557720545|A.Rogers]] is an 84-overall junior back with 46 snaps in 8 games. A source says the situation is starting to wear on him, a test for Tuddy_roosevelt.

quote.text: He's not complaining, but he wants to play.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557719944:buried.h: Q.Porter is too good to sit at 83 snaps in 8 games
557719944:buried.d: [[p:557719944|Q.Porter]], a 90-overall junior receiver, is watching a lot of football. A source says other programs have inquired about whether he's gettable.

quote.text: A guy like that should be a focal point. He isn't, and everyone sees it.

557714800:struggling.h: B.Ficklin was supposed to be a star. The numbers say otherwise
557714800:struggling.d: [[p:557714800|B.Ficklin]], a 90-overall quarterback, has 14 touchdowns against 7 interceptions and a rating that doesn't match the hype. An offseason decision looms.

quote.text: The talent is obvious. The results haven't followed.
quote.by: a source familiar with the program

557714066:underpaid.h: Liberty has a star RB bargain in K.Davis. It won't last
557714066:underpaid.d: [[p:557714066|K.Davis]], an 88-overall back, makes nothing while peers command around 110K. [[t:832438329|Liberty]] is not built for bidding wars, and richer schools have noticed.

quote.text: He'll get calls the minute the portal opens.
quote.by: a source with a rival program

557720462:fit.h: Bump-and-run star E.Robinson IV may not fit Georgia's struggling pass defense
557720462:fit.d: [[p:557720462|E.Robinson IV]] is a 97-overall press corner on a [[t:832438312|Georgia]] defense ranked 113th of 138 against the pass. Agents have noticed, and so have other programs.

quote.text: He's a lockdown guy stuck in a unit that doesn't let him lock anybody down. He's going to look around.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557726198:underpaid.h: Rival collectives are sniffing around Georgia safety J.Smith over a pay gap
557726198:underpaid.d: [[p:557726198|J.Smith]] is an 86-overall safety earning nothing in NIL, while comparable players reportedly command around 80K. [[t:832438312|Georgia]] has the deepest NIL pockets in the country, and that may be the only thing keeping him from listening.

quote.text: Everybody knows what the market pays at that position. Somebody is going to put a number in front of him.
quote.by: a collective staffer at a rival school

557715998:struggling.h: T.Hawkins has the rating of a star and the stats of a question mark
557715998:struggling.d: [[p:557715998|T.Hawkins]], an 88-overall quarterback on a ranked team, has 17 touchdowns against 8 interceptions. A source says the staff is bracing for a big offseason call.

quote.text: On a ranked team, you need more than he's giving them.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557725512:sinking.h: Arizona's I.Mizell would be the portal's top prize if he leaves a 2-5 team
557725512:sinking.d: [[p:557725512|I.Mizell]] is a 91-overall junior receiver playing for a team that's 2-5. Contenders have already started plotting how they'd pitch him if he enters the portal.

quote.text: You don't waste a talent like that on a losing season. Every offensive coordinator in the country has his tape up.

557719455:sinking.h: D.Olugbode deserves better than 1-7. Contenders will call
557719455:sinking.d: [[p:557719455|D.Olugbode]], a 91-overall junior receiver, is stuck on a 1-7 Michigan State team. A source says a few contenders are already thinking about the portal.

quote.text: He's too good to be wasting years on this record.

557724828:sinking.h: S.Hiter would be portal's top prize if Michigan loses him
557724828:sinking.d: [[p:557724828|S.Hiter]], a 90-overall sophomore back, is on a 2-7 Michigan team. A source says rival staffs are already working out how they'd pitch him.

quote.text: If he hits the portal, every contender has to call.

557714937:struggling.h: J.Foley was billed as a star receiver, but the stat sheet isn't backing it up
557714937:struggling.d: [[p:557714937|J.Foley]] is an 87-overall receiver with 13 catches for 241 yards through seven games. His staff expected much more, and a hard offseason decision may be coming.

quote.text: The talent is obvious. The production just isn't there, and that conversation is coming.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557722222:struggling.h: B.Trimble rates 86 overall, but 13 catches for 136 yards isn't cutting it
557722222:struggling.d: [[p:557722222|B.Trimble]] has been quiet through seven games, and his staff may look at receivers in the portal. An 86-overall player is expected to be a bigger part of the offense.

quote.text: He's been a non-factor, and the coaches know it. They'll shop that position.

831914682:upset.h: [[t:832438343|Mississippi State]] stuns No. 10 [[t:832438312|Georgia]] in a shootout, 45-38
831914682:upset.d: Mississippi State outgained the Bulldogs 612 to 552 and left Georgia's playoff hopes in pieces. A Georgia source says the postgame locker room was 'dead quiet' and the defense took it hardest.

quote.text: We got outcoached and outplayed on the back end. That's on all of us.
quote.by: a source close to the Georgia program

chase:kickFieldGoalsMade:557712566:10.h: [[p:557712566|R.Clay]] is closing in on the NCAA field goal record
chase:kickFieldGoalsMade:557712566:10.d: With 21 made field goals through nine games, Clay is 10 shy of Billy Bennett's mark of 31, set at Georgia in 2003. At his current pace he would land right around it. One staffer says offenses are now content to stall inside the 30.

quote.text: Honestly, if we cross midfield, he's money. Coaches know it.

chase:receivingYards:557725041:10.h: [[p:557725041|R.Jones]] is on a record-setting pace and defenses know it
chase:receivingYards:557725041:10.d: R.Jones has 1,361 receiving yards through eight games, 699 shy of Trevor Insley's 2,060 from Nevada in 1999. His pace would shatter the record, and one rival coordinator says every week is a new bracket plan.

quote.text: You can't hide a corner on him. We game-planned for him all week and still got burned.

831914497:comeback.h: [[t:832438342|Minnesota]] storms back from a 10-point deficit and stuns [[t:832438348|Nebraska]]
831914497:comeback.d: Nebraska led 31-21 after three quarters and then watched Minnesota win the fourth 21-0 for a 42-31 final. Per a source, the Huskers' sideline got tense as the lead evaporated.

quote.text: Guys stopped talking on the sideline. You could feel it slipping.
quote.by: a source close to the Nebraska program

831914014:ot.h: [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] falls to [[t:832438309|Florida Atlantic]] in overtime, 38-28
831914014:ot.d: Regulation couldn't separate them, but the extra period went the Owls' way. Pirate_flag now has another tough one to answer for, just a week after the quarterback questions from the five-interception loss.

quote.text: We had it. We just didn't finish. That's what keeps coaches up at night.
quote.by: a source close to the East Carolina program

831914839:pass:557726977.h: [[p:557726977|D.Bell]] shreds [[t:832438293|Clemson]] for 415 yards and five touchdowns
831914839:pass:557726977.d: Bell went 37-of-47 without a pick as Miami won 38-22. A Clemson defensive source says the Tigers 'had no answer' for the underneath stuff, and the staff is likely to hear about it after last week's 39-38 comeback escape.

quote.text: He was calm all day. Every read was right.

831914454:4th:832438410.h: [[t:832438410|West Virginia]] goes 0-for-4 on fourth down and the fans are furious
831914454:4th:832438410.d: The Mountaineers turned it over on downs four times in the loss to [[t:832438295|Colorado]]. Message boards are fuming over the aggression, and a source says some boosters are already asking questions.

quote.text: You can't keep giving a team the ball back like that and expect to win.

831914507:4th:832438394.h: [[t:832438394|UCLA]] goes 4-for-4 on fourth down and takes down [[t:832438364|Oregon]]
831914507:4th:832438394.d: UCLA kept its offense on the field every time and every conversion shifted momentum. A Bruins source said the plan was set before kickoff: 'We're not punting in the red zone.'

quote.text: Coach told us on Wednesday we were going. Nobody blinked.

831914682:pass:557721882.h: [[p:557721882|K.Taylor]] torches [[t:832438312|Georgia]] for 409 yards and four touchdowns
831914682:pass:557721882.d: Taylor went 31-of-45 with one interception in the 45-38 Mississippi State win. The Georgia secondary got picked apart all day and scouts are noticing. A rival recruiter says Georgia's defense suddenly looks like a pitch point for Texas.

quote.text: Taylor just kept finding the soft spot. Georgia couldn't get off the field.

831914731:int:557711606.h: [[p:557711606|L.Anderson III]] throws three picks as [[t:832438377|South Carolina]] falls to [[t:832438344|Missouri]]
831914731:int:557711606.d: Anderson finished 15-of-29 for 201 yards and a touchdown, but the three interceptions did the damage. One source says the quarterback stayed late at the facility after the loss to watch film alone.

quote.text: He knows he forced it. He's hard on himself.
quote.by: a source close to the South Carolina program

831914774:pass:557727038.h: [[p:557727038|F.Brandon]] puts up 434 yards as Tennessee beats [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]]
831914774:pass:557727038.d: Brandon went 29-of-43 with four touchdowns and no interceptions in the 35-23 win. Oklahoma's secondary is hearing it, and with the fight for WILL B. Toviessi heating up, a rival recruiter says the loss could 'hurt the pitch.'

quote.text: They couldn't cover our guys, plain and simple.

831914131:rivalry.h: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] keeps the trophy with a 45-35 win over [[t:832438346|Navy]]
831914131:rivalry.d: The Irish owned the rivalry again and Navy's staff will have to answer for the defensive lapses. A source close to the Navy program called the loss 'a gut punch' after a strong week of preparation.

quote.text: We had them where we wanted them. We just couldn't stop the big plays.
quote.by: a source close to the Navy program

831914431:rivalry.h: [[t:832438288|BYU]] takes the Holy War in a one-sided rivalry win
831914431:rivalry.d: BYU has bragging rights for another year after a game that was never close. A Utah booster says patience is thinning and the program 'needs answers,' though no change is expected.

quote.text: This was supposed to be the game we circled. It wasn't even competitive.

831914420:pass:557715753.h: [[p:557715753|W.Hammond]] drops 432 yards on [[t:832438317|Houston]] as Texas Tech cruises, 52-34
831914420:pass:557715753.d: Hammond went 32-of-47 with three touchdowns and no turnovers. Houston's staff, per a source, feels the defense 'lost the plot' on third down as Texas Tech dictated the pace.

quote.text: Hammond was surgical. We couldn't touch him.
quote.by: a source close to the Houston program

831914547:4th:832438345.h: [[t:832438345|Missouri State]]'s fourth-down gambles backfire against [[t:832438326|Kennesaw State]]
831914547:4th:832438345.d: Missouri State went 2-for-4 on fourth down, turning it over on downs twice. Analytics people will defend it, but the fan base is not buying it and the coach is facing pressure, according to a source.

quote.text: You can't live in the numbers when you're losing games.
quote.by: a Missouri State fan on a message board

831914803:int:557713884.d: Duval threw for 297 yards on 20-of-35 but never found the end zone, and Louisiana Tech's defenders feasted on his mistakes. A source says the quarterback will have a lot to think about this week.

quote.text: We knew where he was going with it. We just sat on it.

831914847:int:557726550.h: Four picks from [[p:557726550|T.Walker III]] sink [[t:832438299|Duke]] against [[t:832438406|Virginia Tech]]
831914847:int:557726550.d: Walker threw three touchdowns but four interceptions, finishing 16-of-37 for 252 yards. A source says the sideline tension was visible as Duke's offense kept handing the ball back.

quote.text: He's a fighter, but those throws can't happen.
quote.by: a source close to the Duke program

831914422:int:557723614.h: [[p:557723614|K.Annett]] throws three interceptions as [[t:832438393|UCF]] falls to [[t:832438283|Baylor]]
831914422:int:557723614.d: Annett put up 331 yards and two touchdowns on 23-of-42, but the three picks defined the loss. A source says the Knights' staff is already working on cleaning up decision-making.

quote.text: He got greedy a couple times. It happens.
quote.by: a source close to the UCF program

831914740:ot.d: Regulation couldn't settle it, and Arkansas State took the extra period. A source says Southern Miss will wonder about a couple of late calls, and the loss stings on the road.

quote.text: We had chances. We just didn't take them.
quote.by: a source close to the Southern Miss program

831914472:shutout.h: [[t:832438413|Wisconsin]] blanks [[t:832438340|Michigan State]] with a dominant defensive effort
831914472:shutout.d: Michigan State managed just 108 yards and three first downs. A source says Spartans players were frustrated with the play-calling and the offense never found a rhythm.

quote.text: Nothing worked. We couldn't get anything going.
quote.by: a source close to the Michigan State program

831914637:def:557721152.h: [[p:557721152|G.Sims]] wrecks [[t:832438374|San Jose State]]'s backfield in a losing effort
831914637:def:557721152.d: Sims had three sacks and four tackles for loss among six tackles, a monster game wasted in defeat. Per a source, several bigger programs have taken notice and phone calls could be coming.

quote.text: He's a problem every snap. You can't block him.

831914266:flags:832438297.h: [[t:832438297|UConn]] flagged 11 times in a sloppy loss to [[t:832438367|Pittsburgh]]
831914266:flags:832438297.d: UConn's 11 penalties cost it 80 yards and a chance at the win. A source says the staff plans a tough, disciplined week of practice.

quote.text: We beat ourselves. Plain and simple.
quote.by: a source close to the UConn program

831914594:flags:832438282.h: [[t:832438282|Ball State]] commits 13 penalties in loss to [[t:832438412|Western Michigan]]
831914594:flags:832438282.d: Ball State was flagged 13 times for 114 yards, handing Western Michigan the game. A source says the coach was heated after the game and discipline will be the focus this week.

quote.text: Coach was fired up in the locker room. It was ugly.
quote.by: a source close to the Ball State program

831914777:rec:557727732.h: [[p:557727732|B.Irvin III]] burns [[t:832438384|Texas]] for 181 yards and two scores
831914777:rec:557727732.d: Irvin caught five passes and Texas had no answer even after bracketing him. A source says the Longhorns' defensive staff is searching for answers, which could ripple into recruiting where Texas is chasing P. Leber.

quote.text: We doubled him and he still won. That's what hurts.
quote.by: a source close to the Texas program

831914481:blowout.d: Michigan piled up 635 yards and never let Illinois breathe. A source says the Illini locker room was heated afterward and players are frustrated, which could fuel portal chatter.

quote.text: It wasn't even a game. We got embarrassed.
quote.by: a source close to the Illinois program

831914053:rec:557721289.d: Smith caught six passes for 56 yards and three scores, and Rice's bracket coverage did nothing. A source says other programs are already monitoring his situation as a potential transfer target.

quote.text: He makes every contested catch look easy.

831914421:3rd:832438325.h: [[t:832438325|Kansas State]] goes 2-for-13 on third down in a loss to [[t:832438276|Arizona]]
831914421:3rd:832438325.d: Drives kept dying on the money down for Kansas State. A source says the staff has been 'searching for answers' on third-and-long calls and fans are getting restless.

quote.text: Every third down felt like a punt waiting to happen.
quote.by: a source close to the Kansas State program

831914805:rec:557718738.d: Mikhael caught six passes for 55 yards and four scores despite the bracket coverage. A source says scouts are already adding him to watch lists, and Coastal Carolina's secondary will be hearing about it.

quote.text: He's always in the right place. You can't cover that.

561125416battle.h: LSU and Michigan stage a late fight for TE D. Skaggs
561125416battle.d: [[t:832438333|LSU]] holds the edge, but [[t:832438339|Michigan]] isn't folding, and Ohio State is lurking. Skaggs wants a championship contender, and that dealbreaker cuts differently for each school.

quote.text: He keeps asking one question: who's actually playing for something in December?
quote.by: a source close to the recruitment

561123261battle.h: BYU barely ahead of Washington for C N. Punga, with A&M lurking
561123261battle.d: Conference prestige is the dealbreaker for the four-star center. [[t:832438288|BYU]] has a slight lead on [[t:832438408|Washington]], and [[t:832438385|Texas A&M]] is close enough to crash the finish.

quote.text: The family likes the Provo visit a lot. The league question is what keeps coming up.
quote.by: a source familiar with the process

561119642battle.h: Colorado clings to a lead for MIKE D. Donnell as Florida State closes
561119642battle.d: Playing style is Donnell's dealbreaker. [[t:832438295|Colorado]] is in front, [[t:832438408|Washington]] is still in it, and Florida State has crept to within striking distance.

quote.text: He wants to be used as a weapon, not a spot in the rotation.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

561123500commit.h: No. 27 overall J. Barkow picks Oklahoma, sees a quick path to the field
561123500commit.d: [[r:561123500|J. Barkow]] chose [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] for the national spotlight and a thin receiver room. Seven returning receivers leaves room for a newcomer to climb fast.

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.

561121905commit.h: LSU lands five-star WR J. Kirkendoll after rivalry rout of A&M
561121905commit.d: [[t:832438333|LSU]] gets a headliner for a receiver room about to lose [[p:557724385|M.Elzy]]. A source says the win over [[t:832438385|Texas A&M]] sealed what the depth chart had already started.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.

561125329commit.h: Notre Dame wins No. 32 overall LB H. Wonnum with a draft-board pitch
561125329commit.d: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] sold linebacker pipeline, and the rivalry win over [[t:832438346|Navy]] helped. A source says the staff walked [[r:561125329|H. Wonnum]] through the program's recent draft picks at the position.

quote.text: They showed me the draft board. That's where I'm going.

561119508commit.h: Texas Tech's winning ways land four-star ATH C. Eze
561119508commit.d: [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] is 7-2 and ranked No. 12, and Eze bought in to the staff. A source says he never really considered anywhere else after seeing the Red Raiders play.

quote.text: They win. I want to win. Easy.

561124659commit.h: Oklahoma beats Texas and LSU for M. Avril, who wanted the lights
561124659commit.d: [[r:561124659|M. Avril]] stays near Keller and picks [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] over [[t:832438384|Texas]] and [[t:832438333|LSU]]. Rival staffers admit the brand and the drive from home were tough to match.

quote.text: Big stage, big brand. I want the lights.

561121137commit.h: Michigan beats Washington and USC for Q. Rheem on conference pull
561121137commit.d: Michigan's 2-7 record hasn't killed its recruiting. [[r:561121137|Q. Rheem]] wanted a power-conference stage, and the 49-14 win over [[t:832438318|Illinois]] gave the staff something to sell.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

561124348commit.h: East Carolina keeps K. Meyers home, beating South Carolina
561124348commit.d: A short drive from Marietta helped, but a source says [[c:H0ldStillPlease|H0ldStillPlease]] personally closing it was the real difference. A needed win for a program that's been hurting.

quote.text: I wanted to stay close to home. East Carolina just felt like family.

561119858commit.h: East Carolina adds REDG S. Stepanovich as edge room turns over
561119858commit.d: With [[p:557711449|K.Agurs]] and [[p:557721127|B.Simms III]] both seniors, [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] needed edge help. Stepanovich liked the power-conference feel and a clear path to snaps.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

561125156commit.h: Oregon's NIL muscle lands four-star QB F. Brockel
561125156commit.d: [[t:832438364|Oregon]] used television exposure and its spending power to get [[r:561125156|F. Brockel]]. A source says the reported $310K asking price was never a sticking point.

quote.text: Every week we're on TV. That matters for my brand.

561123155commit.h: Indiana turns upset of Penn State into four-star LEDG G. Brown
561123155commit.d: Brown wants rings, and the win over No. 18 [[t:832438366|Penn State]] made [[t:832438319|Indiana]]'s title pitch sound real. It also dents Agerm40's recent momentum.

quote.text: I want rings. Simple as that.

561122974commit.h: Nebraska beats Minnesota for WR J. Elling, with Gilmer leaving
561122974commit.d: [[r:561122974|J. Elling]] chose [[t:832438348|Nebraska]] for the Big Ten stage and a room that opens up when [[p:557715333|K.Gilmer]] leaves. [[t:832438342|Minnesota]] hoped its pitch would hold.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

561124133commit.h: Michigan lands four-star REDG G. Carver, who watched the Illinois rout
561124133commit.d: [[t:832438339|Michigan]] has a strong DL draft record, and the 49-14 win over [[t:832438318|Illinois]] helped. A source says Carver attended and left convinced.

quote.text: That win over Illinois? I was in the stands. That's when I knew.

561125142commit.h: One-star WILL D. Ghent skips home dealbreaker to join East Carolina
561125142commit.d: Ghent wanted to stay close to home, then picked [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] across the country. The thin linebacker room and an open-job pitch swayed him, according to a source.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.

557720624:underpaid.h: Rival collectives circling UCLA's B.Rowe Jr. as pay gap grows
557720624:underpaid.d: [[p:557720624|B.Rowe Jr.]] is a 91-overall receiver making 60K while peers get far more. [[t:832438394|UCLA]] has deep NIL pockets, but rival schools are making calls.

quote.text: Everyone in this business knows what he's worth. UCLA needs to catch up.

557713264:struggling.h: J.Carter's ratings say star, but 3.8 a carry says otherwise
557713264:struggling.d: [[p:557713264|J.Carter]] has 625 yards on 164 carries for a ranked team. A source says the staff is watching the portal for a back who can make more of those runs.

quote.text: The rating is there. The production isn't, and people are noticing.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557724785:struggling.h: Notre Dame weighs a change at QB with K.Henderson's numbers
557724785:struggling.d: [[p:557724785|K.Henderson]]'s 19 touchdowns and 6 interceptions aren't terrible, but expectations for an 89-overall quarterback are high. A source says [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] is quietly considering options.

quote.text: It's not a crisis, but the staff isn't sold either.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557712922:sinking.h: J.Buchanan deserves better than 2-7. Contenders will call
557712922:sinking.d: [[p:557712922|J.Buchanan]], an 88-overall junior receiver, is stuck on the same 2-7 Michigan ship as S.Hiter. Another departure would hurt the Wolverines' rebuild.

quote.text: Michigan is losing in the standings and may start losing in the portal.
quote.by: a source with a rival program
